terms.title: Clear scope. Clear process. Clear investment.

items.label: Payment
items.value: Standalone projects up to IDR 5 million: 50% kickoff, 50% before final handover. Combo/multi-service: 40% kickoff, 40% after main creative/production approval, 20% before handover. Custom projects follow quotation milestones.

items.label: Revisions
items.value: A maximum of 1-2 rounds according to the package/agreement; additional revisions become an add-on or Change Request.

items.label: Proposal
items.value: The final quotation is valid for 14 days. Timeline begins after kickoff payment and minimum materials/dependencies are available.

items.label: Ownership
items.value: Final project-specific deliverables are handed over after full payment; third-party assets remain subject to their licences.

items.label: Raw / source files
items.value: RAW photos and unedited/raw video footage are excluded unless agreed in writing.

items.label: Production exclusions
items.value: Domain/hosting, premium licences, printing, studio/location, talent/model/MUA, custom props, permits, travel, extra cameras, special lighting, drone, and specific equipment are priced separately.

items.label: Tax & warranty
items.value: Prices exclude required taxes where applicable. Websites include 14 days of in-scope technical bug fixes; creative files include 7 days for export/file-error corrections.

terms.launchNote: Launch Pricing 2026 applies to selected early-partner projects and may be updated. Final pricing is confirmed only once the scope is sufficiently clear; revenue, SEO ranking, lead volume, views, or engagement are not guaranteed.

disciplines.name: Website
disciplines.description: Discovery covers sitemap and content needs; Create moves through design before development; Review includes a QA pass before launch.

disciplines.name: Design
disciplines.description: Define locks the brief and reference direction; Create iterates through concepts to a refined system; Deliver includes source files and usage guidance.

disciplines.name: Photography
disciplines.description: Define sets shot list and location; Create is the shoot itself, followed by selects and retouching; Deliver hands over final files in the agreed formats.

disciplines.name: Film
disciplines.description: Define covers script or concept and shot list; Create spans production and edit; Review moves through cut approvals before final delivery.

about.heroSubtitle: Karsa Agency is the space in between — where a business intention becomes a complete digital and visual presence.
about.philosophyBody: Karsa Agency helps businesses build a complete digital and visual presence through website, design, photography, and video — under one creative direction. Business explains why something is built. Design shapes how people see and feel it. Technology makes sure it all works — reliably, maintainably, and ready to grow.

values.name: Thoughtful
values.description: Every decision is made deliberately, not by default or convention.

values.name: Modern
values.description: Current tools and practices, applied without chasing trends for their own sake.

values.name: Professional

values.name: Honest

values.name: Human
